dedupe_keys.name: moving target defense based secured network slicing system in the o ran architecture

description: The model uses mathematical optimization on a longer time scale to choose numbers of virtual network functions and PPO reinforcement learning on a shorter time scale for slice admission and power management. A moving-target defence adds uncertainty to strengthen the learned policy against poisoning. Experiments report admission above 80 percent in the studied conditions. This identifies an implemented telecom resource-control model, without establishing performance against all threats or real commercial deployment.
